mcq.q: In an 8-bit Sign-Magnitude system, how is the decimal number -37 represented? (The magnitude of 37 in binary is 0100101 ).
What is a major disadvantage of the Sign-Magnitude representation?

options.A: a) It is difficult for humans to understand.
options.B: b) It requires complex hardware to perform addition and subtraction because it requires both an adder and a subtractor, and a magnitude comparator. .
options.C: c) It cannot represent negative numbers.
options.D: d) It uses more bits than Two's Complement

mcq.answer_text: b) It requires complex hardware to perform addition and subtraction because it requires both an adder and a subtractor, and a magnitude comparator. .
